articles.title: Muslim Women Rights Day — 1 August (Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019)
articles.title_hi: मुस्लिम महिला अधिकार दिवस — 1 अगस्त (Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019)
articles.summary: India observes 1 August as Muslim Women Rights Day to mark the enactment of the law criminalising instant triple talaq (talaq-e-biddat), which received presidential assent on 1 August 2019.
articles.summary_hi: भारत 1 अगस्त को मुस्लिम महिला अधिकार दिवस के रूप में मनाता है, जो त्वरित तriple talaq (talaq-e-biddat) को दंडनीय बनाने वाले कानून की वर्षगांठ है, जिसे 1 अगस्त 2019 को राष्ट्रपति की स्वीकृति मिली।
articles.content:
Muslim Women Rights Day is observed in India on 1 August every year. It commemorates the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, which criminalises the practice of instant triple talaq (talaq-e-biddat). The Bill was passed by Parliament in July 2019 and received presidential assent on 1 August 2019.

The law makes declaration of instant triple talaq void and illegal, with provision for imprisonment up to three years for the husband. It aims to protect the rights of Muslim women and ensure gender justice.

For IB ACIO: Muslim Women Rights Day — 1 August, Act assented 2019, criminalises talaq-e-biddat.
articles.content_hi:
Muslim Women Rights Day: 1 अगस्त। अधिनियम — 2019 (1 Aug assent)। talaq-e-biddat — void/illegal, अधिकतम 3 वर्ष कारावास।

IB ACIO: 1 August 2019 — याद रखें।
articles.question: Muslim Women Rights Day in India, observed on 1 August, marks the presidential assent to the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act in:
articles.question_hi: भारत में 1 अगस्त को मनाया जाने वाला मुस्लिम महिला अधिकार दिवस Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act को राष्ट्रपति की स्वीकृति किस वर्ष मिली, इसकी वर्षगांठ है?
articles.explanation: The Act received presidential assent on 1 August 2019.
articles.explanation_hi: अधिनियम को 1 अगस्त 2019 को राष्ट्रपति की स्वीकृति मिली।

articles.title: World Breastfeeding Week 2026 Begins — Theme 'Breastfeeding in Crisis and Emergencies'
articles.title_hi: विश्व स्तनपान सप्ताह 2026 शुरू — थीम 'Breastfeeding in Crisis and Emergencies'
articles.summary: World Breastfeeding Week is observed annually from 1–7 August to promote breastfeeding for child survival, nutrition, and health, with WHO and UNICEF advocacy support.
articles.summary_hi: विश्व स्तनपान सप्ताह प्रतिवर्ष 1-7 अगस्त को बाल जीवन रक्षा, पोषण और स्वास्थ्य हेतु स्तनपान को बढ़ावा देने के लिए मनाया जाता है, जिसमें WHO और UNICEF का समर्थन होता है।
articles.content:
World Breastfeeding Week (WBW) is observed globally from 1 to 7 August each year. It commemorates the 1990 Innocenti Declaration on breastfeeding protection, promotion, and support. WHO and UNICEF jointly advocate exclusive breastfeeding for the first six months.

The 2026 theme, 'Breastfeeding in Crisis and Emergencies', highlights the importance of protecting, promoting, and supporting breastfeeding during disasters and humanitarian emergencies when infant formula supply chains may be disrupted.

For IB ACIO: WBW — 1-7 August, Innocenti Declaration 1990, WHO-UNICEF.
articles.content_hi:
World Breastfeeding Week: 1-7 अगस्त। Innocenti Declaration — 1990। 2026 थीम — 'Breastfeeding in Crisis and Emergencies'।

IB ACIO: WBW 1-7 Aug — याद रखें।

articles.title: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana Registration Portal Opens
articles.title_hi: दिल्ली लक्ष्मी योजना पंजीकरण पोर्टल खुला
articles.summary: Registration for the Delhi Lakshmi Yojana opened on 1 August 2026, allowing eligible women aged 21-60 to apply for Rs 2,500 monthly assistance under the scheme approved in July.
articles.summary_hi: दिल्ली लक्ष्मी योजना के लिए पंजीकरण 1 अगस्त 2026 को खुला, जिससे 21-60 वर्ष की पात्र महिलाएं जुलाई में स्वीकृत योजना के तहत 2,500 रुपये मासिक सहायता हेतु आवेदन कर सकती हैं।
articles.content:
On 1 August 2026, the Delhi government opened registration for the 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana', approved by the cabinet led by Chief Minister Rekha Gupta in July 2026. Eligible women aged 21-60 with annual family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh and at least 10 years' Delhi residency can apply online.

The first installment is scheduled for 28 August 2026 (Raksha Bandhan). Beneficiaries may opt for Rs 1,500 in RD/FD plus Rs 1,000 in a CBDC digital rupee wallet, or the full Rs 2,500 in RD/FD.

For IB ACIO: Registration — 1 Aug 2026, first installment — 28 Aug 2026, amount — Rs 2,500/month.
articles.content_hi:
Delhi Lakshmi Yojana: पंजीकरण — 1 अगस्त 2026। पहली किस्त — 28 अगस्त 2026। राशि — Rs 2,500/माह। CM — Rekha Gupta।

IB ACIO: Registration 1 Aug — याद रखें।

articles.title_hi: CWG 2026 दिन 9: भारत ने मुक्केबाजी में क्लस्टर जीता; एथलेटिक्स फाइनल जारी
articles.summary: On Day 9 (1 August) of Glasgow 2026, India secured multiple boxing medals including golds, as athletics and track cycling delivered another 44-gold-medal day before the closing ceremony.
articles.summary_hi: ग्लासगो 2026 के 9वें दिन (1 अगस्त) भारत ने मुक्केबाजी में कई पदक including स्वर्ण जीते, जबकि समापन समारोह से पहले एथलेटिक्स और ट्रैक साइकिलिंग ने 44 स्वर्ण पदक वाला दिन दिया।
articles.content:
Day 9 (1 August) of the 2026 Commonwealth Games featured 44 gold medal events — among the busiest days alongside Day 8. India's boxing contingent added to the medal tally with podium finishes across weight categories at the SEC Centre.

Track cycling finals at the Sir Chris Hoy Velodrome and athletics at Scotstoun Stadium dominated the schedule. India remained in contention for a top-five finish in the overall medal table going into the final day.

For IB ACIO: CWG 2026 Day 9 — 1 August, 44 gold events, boxing and athletics highlights.

CWG 2026, Day 9 (1 अगस्त): 44 स्वर्ण पदक कार्यक्रम। भारत — boxing medals, athletics/track cycling finals।

articles.title: World Lung Cancer Day — 1 August
articles.title_hi: विश्व फेफड़े के कैंसर दिवस — 1 अगस्त
articles.summary: World Lung Cancer Day on 1 August raises awareness about lung cancer prevention, early detection, and the impact of tobacco use and air pollution on respiratory health.
articles.summary_hi: 1 अगस्त को विश्व फेफड़े के कैंसर दिवस फेफड़े के कैंसर की रोकथाम, शीघ्र निदान, और तंबाकू व प्रदूषण के प्रभाव पर जागरूकता बढ़ाता है।
articles.content:
World Lung Cancer Day is observed annually on 1 August to raise global awareness about lung cancer — one of the most common and deadliest cancers worldwide. Campaigns emphasise smoking cessation, screening for high-risk groups, and research funding.

In India, lung cancer incidence is linked to tobacco use (bidi, cigarette, smokeless tobacco) and growing concerns over ambient air pollution in urban centres. WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (FCTC) remains the key global treaty for tobacco control.

For IB ACIO: World Lung Cancer Day — 1 August, tobacco control, WHO FCTC.
articles.content_hi:
World Lung Cancer Day: 1 अगस्त। भारत — tobacco, air pollution। WHO FCTC — वैश्विक tobacco control संधि।

IB ACIO: 1 August — याद रखें।

articles.title: GST Collections Cross Rs 2.05 Lakh Crore in July 2026
articles.title_hi: जुलाई 2026 में GST संग्रह 2.05 लाख करोड़ रुपये पार
articles.summary: India's gross GST revenue in July 2026 (for June transactions) crossed Rs 2.05 lakh crore, marking sustained compliance growth and robust festive-quarter economic activity.
articles.summary_hi: जुलाई 2026 (जून लेनदेन) में भारत का सकल GST राजस्व 2.05 लाख करोड़ रुपये पार कर गया, जो निरंतर अनुपालन वृद्धि और मजबूत आर्थिक गतिविधि दर्शाता है।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Finance Ministry reported that gross GST collections for July 2026 (reflecting June transactions) exceeded Rs 2.05 lakh crore. Central GST, State GST, Integrated GST, and cess components all showed year-on-year growth.

Officials attributed the figure to improved compliance, e-invoicing, and steady demand in manufacturing and services. The milestone comes ahead of the GST Council's scheduled review of rate rationalisation on select items.

For IB ACIO: GST July 2026 collection — Rs 2.05 lakh crore+, Finance Ministry.

GST collection (July 2026, June txn): Rs 2.05 lakh crore+। घटक — CGST, SGST, IGST, cess।

articles.title: India Deploys AI-Based Flood Early Warning System in Northeast
articles.title_hi: भारत ने पूर्वोत्तर में AI-आधारित बाढ़ पूर्व चेतावनी प्रणाली तैनात की
articles.summary: The Central Water Commission and IMD launched an AI-integrated flood forecasting pilot for Brahmaputra and Barak basins, providing 5-day lead-time alerts to Assam and Meghalaya districts.
articles.summary_hi: केंद्रीय जल आयोग और IMD ने ब्रह्मपुत्र और बarak बेसिन के लिए AI-एकीकृत बाढ़ पूर्वानुमान पायलट शुरू किया, जो Assam और Meghalaya जिलों को 5-दिन पूर्व चेतावनी देगा।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Central Water Commission (CWC) and India Meteorological Department (IMD) deployed an AI-based flood early warning system for the Brahmaputra and Barak river basins. The system integrates satellite rainfall estimates, river gauge data, and machine-learning models for 5-day forecasts.

The pilot covers flood-prone districts in Assam and Meghalaya during the monsoon season. Alerts are disseminated through the Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) to state disaster management authorities.

For IB ACIO: CWC + IMD, AI flood warning, Brahmaputra-Barak basins, 5-day lead time.
articles.content_hi:
AI Flood EWS: CWC + IMD। क्षेत्र — Brahmaputra, Barak basins (Assam, Meghalaya)। 5-day lead time, CAP alerts।

IB ACIO: CWC-IMD AI flood — याद रखें।

articles.title: Justice Surya Kant Sworn In as Executive Chairman, NALSA
articles.title_hi: न्यायमूर्ति सूर्य कांत NALSA के कार्यकारी अध्यक्ष के रूप में शपथबद्ध
articles.summary: Supreme Court judge Justice Surya Kant assumed charge as Executive Chairman of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA), succeeding Justice B.R. Gavai.
articles.summary_hi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायमूर्ति सूर्य कांत ने राष्ट्रीय विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण (NALSA) के कार्यकारी अध्यक्ष का कार्यभार संभाला, जो न्यायमूर्ति बी.आर. गवई का स्थान लेंगे।
articles.content:
In August 2026, Justice Surya Kant, Judge of the Supreme Court of India, was sworn in as Executive Chairman of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA). The post is held ex officio by a sitting Supreme Court judge designated by the Chief Justice of India.

NALSA, constituted under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, provides free legal aid to weaker sections. August 2026 also marks ongoing National Lok Adalat drives across states.

For IB ACIO: NALSA — Legal Services Authorities Act 1987, Executive Chairman is SC judge.
articles.content_hi:
NALSA: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987। Executive Chairman — sitting SC judge (Justice Surya Kant, Aug 2026)।

articles.title: PM Dedicates Rewa Solar Park Phase-II Expansion in Madhya Pradesh
articles.title_hi: PM ने मध्य प्रदेश में रीवा सोलर पार्क Phase-II विस्तार को समर्पित किया
articles.summary: The Prime Minister dedicated the Phase-II expansion of the Rewa Ultra Mega Solar Park, adding 750 MW capacity and reinforcing India's renewable energy targets under the Panchamrit goals.
articles.summary_hi: प्रधानमंत्री ने रीवा अल्ट्रा मेगा सोलर पार्क के Phase-II विस्तार को समर्पित किया, जिससे 750 MW क्षमता जुड़ी और पंचमृत लक्ष्यों के तहत नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा लक्ष्य मजबूत हुए।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Prime Minister dedicated the Phase-II expansion of the Rewa Ultra Mega Solar Park in Madhya Pradesh, adding 750 MW to one of India's landmark solar projects. Rewa Solar Park was among the first interstate solar projects supplying power to Delhi Metro and Madhya Pradesh discoms.

The expansion supports India's 500 GW non-fossil capacity target by 2030 under Panchamrit commitments announced at COP26. Rewa district has emerged as a solar hub in the Bundelkhand region.

For IB ACIO: Rewa Solar Park, MP, Phase-II +750 MW, Panchamrit/COP26 targets.
articles.content_hi:
Rewa Solar Park (MP): Phase-II +750 MW। COP26 Panchamrit — 500 GW non-fossil by 2030। Delhi Metro को भी बिजली।

IB ACIO: Rewa Solar — याद रखें।

articles.title: ASEAN-India FTA Review Negotiations Conclude in Jakarta
articles.title_hi: जकार्ता में ASEAN-India FTA समीक्षा वार्ता संपन्न
articles.summary: India and ASEAN concluded a review of their 2010 FTA in goods, agreeing to expand tariff concessions on electronics, pharmaceuticals, and agricultural products over a phased timeline.
articles.summary_hi: भारत और ASEAN ने 2010 वस्तुओं FTA की समीक्षा पूरी की, जिसमें इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, फार्मास्युटिकल्स और कृषि उत्पादों पर चरणबद्ध तरीके से टैरिफ रियायतें बढ़ाने पर सहमति बनी।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) concluded a review of the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA), originally signed in 2009 and effective from 2010. The review modernises rules of origin and adds chapters on trade facilitation and MSME cooperation.

ASEAN remains a key pillar of India's Act East Policy. Bilateral trade has grown significantly since the FTA, with Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Vietnam among top partners.

For IB ACIO: ASEAN-India FTA in goods — 2010 effective, reviewed 2026, Act East Policy.
articles.content_hi:
ASEAN-India FTA (goods): प्रभावी — 2010। 2026 review — AITIGA। India's Act East Policy।
